tei:div.tei:p:
ק׳קהל אֹמֶץ אַדִּירֵי כָּל חֵפֶץ. בְּהִתְבַּקְּרָם בַּדִּין חֻיְּבוּ לְנַפֵּץ. כְּלֹא נִמְצָא בָהֶם חֵפֶץ: אָדָם יְצִיר עָפָר מֵאֲדָמָה. לְאֵילֵי מָרוֹם אוֹתוֹ דִמָּה. לֹא בָן וְלַהֶבֶל דָּמָה: לַעֲבוֹד וְלִשְׁמוֹר גַּן הִפְרִישׁוֹ. וְעָבַר עַל צִוֻּיוֹ וַיְגָרְשׁוֹ. וְיוֹם זֶה לְיֹשֶׁר דְּרָשׁוֹ: לְעֵת הֵעִיר אֶזְרָח מִמַּאֲפֵל. עוֹלָם הָיָה תֹהוּ וּמְאֻפָּל. עֶשְׂרִים דּוֹר בָּזוּי וְשָׁפָל: עִקְּשִׁים בְּאֹרַח מִישׁוֹר מַסְלוּל יִדַּע. וְעַל נָאֳמוֹ בַּמָּה אֵדַע. נִדּוֹן בְּכֵן יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע: עוֹבְרִים בְּעֵמֶק הַבָּכָא לְהִבָּדֵק. אִם כְּפָעֳלָם בְּרִיב יְדַקְדֵּק. לִפְנֵי שׁוֹפֵט מִי יִצְטַדֵּק: זָךְ הַמַּשְׁלִים בְּעֵקֶד נֶפֶשׁ. בְּזֹקֶן לֹא מָצָא נֹפֶשׁ. וַתִּכְהֶיןָ עֵינָיו בַּעֲשַׁן טִפֵּשׁ: זַרְעוֹ רִגֵּל בְּאָהֳלֵי תוֹרָה. וְעַל אָמְרוֹ דַרְכִּי נִסְתְּרָה. נִכְסָה מֶנּוּ פּוֹרָת בִּסְתִירָה: רָשָׁע אֲשֶׁר בְּמַחְבָּא יְחַתֵּר. צֶדֶק לְפָנָיו יְהַלֵּךְ וִינַתֵּר. אוּלַי בְּיוֹם אַף יִסָּתֵר: רֵעִים שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר כְּהִבְדִּיק. בְּרִיב אוֹתָם לֹא הִצְדִּיק. עַל מִכְרָם בַּכֶּסֶף צַדִּיק: בְּנֵי בְלִי שֵׁם בְּמָכְרָם עֲמוּסִים. בַּזּוֹנָה וּבַיַּיִן וּבְשׁוֹד חֲמָסִים. אֵיךְ בַּדִּין יִהְיוּ נֶעֱמָסִים: בְּהִתְיַצְּבוֹ לָרִיב
בְּעָמְדוֹ לָדִין. עַל זֹאת אוֹתָם יָדִין. לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּן שַׁדּוּן בְּדִין: יֶרֶד אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִיד אֲמָרִים. וְהִדְרִירוְהִדְרִיךְ בְּכוֹר שׁוֹר מֵחֲמוֹרִים. וְנֶעֱנַשׁ בְּשִׁמְעוּ נָא הַמּוֹרִים: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר נוֹקַשׁ בְּעֶשֶׂר. נֶחֶרְתוּ בוֹ מִיתוֹת עֶשֶׂר. וּכְגָע גְּבוּל כֻּבַּל בְּאֵסֶר: רָאשֶׁיהָ אֲשֶׁר בְּשֹׁחַד יִשְׁפּוֹטוּ. אֵיךְ בְּכֵן צֶדֶק יִשָּׁפֵטוּ. כִּי אִם כְּמוֹ שָׁפָטוּ: רוֹבִים עֲלֵי אֵשׁ זָרָה. פָּגְעָה בָם בְּאַף גְּזֵרָה. לְלַמֵּד בָּם פּוֹשְׁעֵי פְזוּרָה: בַּעַר חָמַד מִן הַחֵרֶם. וְנִלְכַּד הוּא וְכָל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ בַּחֵרֶם. מִגָּדִישׁ וְעַד קָמָה וָכֶרֶם: בּוֹגֵד וְשׁוֹדֵד מַה מּוֹעִיל. הוֹן בְּעֶבְרָה לֹא יוֹעִיל. כִּי אִם לְחַלּוֹת פְּנֵי מְלַמֵּד לְהוֹעִיל: יָד שָׁלַח אֱחוֹז בָּאָרוֹן. נַעֲשֶׂה בּוֹ מִשְׁפָּט וְחָרוֹן. מַה יַּעֲשׂוּ עוֹבְרֵי כִּבְנֵי מָרוֹן: יוֹדֵעַ נַגֵּן כְּפָץ בְּחָנֵנִי. נִבְחַן וְנָם חִנָּם חָנֵּנִי. וְאַל תָּבֹא בְּמִשְׁפָּט לְדַיְּנֵנִי: קוֹרְאֵי בְגָרוֹן וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר. אִם פִּשְׁעָם בְּדִין יִסָּפֵר. בְּמַתְּנַת חִנָּם הַיּוֹם יְכֻפָּר: קָצִין כְּגָאָה לְקַטֵּר לַשֵּׁם. נֶגַע בְּמִצְחוֹ זָרַח לְהֵרָשֵׁם. וְנִשְׁפַּט בְּלֹא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם: לְעֵת תָּמוּט רֶגֶל זֵדִים. אֲשֶׁר בָּאוּ לְהֵיכָל מְזִידִים. יִשָּׁפְטוּ בְּמַכְנִיעַ זֵדִים: לְעֵת יְבֻקְרוּ פֹּעֲלֵי שֶׁקֶר. לְהִשָּׁפֵט בְּוִכּוּחַ אַף וְחֵקֶר. יִסָּכֵר פִּי דוֹבְרֵי שָׁקֶר: יָשָׁר מִתְהַלֵּךְ לְפָנָיו בֶּאֱמֶת. אֵיךְ אַחֲרֵי הַדְּבָרִים וְהָאֱמֶת. חִשַּׁב פָּעֳלוֹ אֱלֹהִים אֱמֶת: יְדִיד אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו וְאַחֲרָיו. לֹא קָם כָּמֹהוּ בִּבְחִירָיו. וְאַחֲרֵי כָל זֹאת דִּקְדֵּק אַחֲרָיו: יָבִינוּ כָּל יְצוּרֵי אָרֶץ. אִם כֵּן בִּמְצוּקֵי אָרֶץ. מַה יַּעֲשׂוּ רִשְׁעֵי אָרֶץ: רָאֹה יִרְאוּ יַעֲרֵי שִׂיחִים.
אִם אֵשׁ אָחֲזָה בַּלַּחִים. אָז יָנוּעוּ יְבֵשִׁים כְּסוּחִים: ח׳חזן רְאֵה כִּי אֵין אִישׁ. לְהַפְגִּיעַ בְּעַד בְּנֵי אִישׁ. וְאַתָּה אֵל וְלֹא אִישׁ: רָשׁוּם בִּכְתַב אֱמֶת אֲשַׁנְּנָה. מַעֲשֵׂה כָּל יְמוֹת הַשָּׁנָה. לְרַצּוֹתְךָ בְּשׁוֹפָר אַם שַׁבָּתבְּזִכְרוֹן שׁוֹפָר בְּזֶה רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה:

tei:div.tei:p:
וּנְתַנֶּה תֹּקֶף קְדֻשַּׁת הַיּוֹם. כִּי הוּא נוֹרָא וְאָיוֹם. וּבוֹ תִנָּשֵׂא מַלְכוּתֶךָ. וְיִכּוֹן בְּחֶסֶד כִּסְאֶךָ. וְתֵשֵׁב עָלָיו בֶּאֱמֶת. אֱמֶת, כִּי אַתָּה הוּא דַיָּן וּמוֹכִיחַ וְיוֹדֵעַ וָעֵד. וְכוֹתֵב וְחוֹתֵם וְסוֹפֵר וּמוֹנֶה. וְתִזְכּוֹר כָּל הַנִּשְׁכָּחוֹת. וְתִפְתַּח אֶת סֵפֶר הַזִּכְרוֹנוֹת. וּמֵאֵלָיו יִקָּרֵא. וְחוֹתָם יַד כָּל אָדָם בּוֹ. וּבְשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל יִתָּקַע. וְקוֹל דְּמָמָה דַקָּה יִשָּׁמַע. וּמַלְאָכִים יֵחָפֵזוּן. וְחִיל וּרְעָדָה יֹאחֵזוּן. וְיֹאמְרוּ, הִנֵּה
יוֹם הַדִּין. לִפְקוֹד עַל צְבָא מָרוֹם בַּדִּין. כִּי לֹא יִזְכּוּ בְעֵינֶיךָ בַּדִּין. וְכָל בָּאֵי עוֹלָם תַּעֲבִיריַעַבְרוּן לְפָנֶיךָ כִּבְנֵי מָרוֹן. חזן כְּבַקָּרַת רוֹעֶה עֶדְרוֹ. מַעֲבִיר צֹאנוֹ תַּחַת שִׁבְטוֹ. כֵּן תַּעֲבִיר וְתִסְפּוֹר וְתִמְנֶה. וְתִפְקוֹד נֶפֶשׁ כָּל חָי. וְתַחְתּוֹךְ קִצְבָה לְכָל בְּרִיָּה. וְתִכְתּוֹב אֶת גְּזַר דִּינָם: בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה יִכָּתֵבוּן. וּבְיוֹם (צוֹם) כִּפּוּר יֵחָתֵמוּן. כַּמָּה יַעַבְרוּן. וְכַמָּה יִבָּרֵאוּן. מִי יִחְיֶה. וּמִי יָמוּת. מִי בְקִצּוֹ. וּמִי לֹא בְקִצּוֹ. מִי בָאֵשׁ. וּמִי בַמַּיִם. מִי בַחֶרֶב. (וּמִי בַחַיָּה.) וּמִי בָרָעָב. (וּמִי בַצָּמָא.) מִי בָרַעַשׁ. וּמִי בַמַּגֵּפָה. (מִי בַחֲנִיקָה וּמִי בִסְקִילָה.) מִי יָנוּחַ. וּמִי יָנוּעַ. מִי יִשָּׁקֵט. וּמִי יִטָּרֵף. מִי יִשָּׁלֵו. וּמִי יִתְיַסָּר. מִי יָרוּםיוּרָם וּמִי יִשָּׁפֵל. מִי יֵעָשֵׁר. וּמִי יֵעָנִי:
וּתְשׁוּבָה וּתְפִלָּה וּצְדָקָה מַעֲבִירִין אֶת רוֹעַ הַגְּזֵרָה:

קהל בעטעט ביז ושמנו קראת בשמך.כִּי כְשִׁמְךָ כֵּן תְּהִלָּתֶךָ. קָשֶׁה לִכְעוֹס וְנוֹחַ לִרְצוֹת. כִּי לֹא תַחְפּוֹץ בְּמוֹת הַמֵּת. כִּי אִם בְּשׁוּבוֹ מִדַּרְכּוֹ וְחָיָה. וְעַד יוֹם מוֹתוֹ תְּחַכֶּה לּוֹ. אִם יָשׁוּב מִיָּד תְּקַבְּלוֹ: ח׳חזן אֱמֶת, כִּי אַתָּה הוּא יוֹצְרָם. וְיוֹדֵעַ יִצְרָם. כִּי הֵם בָּשָׂר וָדָם: אָדָם
יְסוֹדוֹ מֵעָפָר וְסוֹפוֹ לֶעָפָר. בְּנַפְשׁוֹ יָבִיא לַחְמוֹ. מָשׁוּל כַּחֶֽרֶס הַנִּשְׁבָּר. כְּחָצִיר יָבֵשׁ. וּכְצִיץ נוֹבֵל. כְּצֵל עוֹבֵר. וְכֶעָנָן כָּלָה. וּכְרוּחַ נוֹשָׁבֶת. וּכְאָבָק פּוֹרֵחַ. וְכַחֲלוֹם יָעוּף:
וְאַתָּה הוּא מֶלֶךְ אֵל חַי וְקַיָּם:

ח׳חזן אֵין קִצְבָה לִשְׁנוֹתֶיךָ. וְאֵין קֵצֶהקֵץ לְאֹרֶךְ יָמֶיךָ. וְאֵין לְשַׁעֵר מַרְכְּבוֹת כְּבוֹדֶךָ. וְאֵין לְפָרֵשׁ עֵילוּם שְׁמֶךָ. שִׁמְךָ נָאֶה לְךָ וְאַתָּה נָאֶה לִשְׁמֶךָ. וּשְׁמֵנוּ קָרָאתָ בִּשְׁמֶךָ: קו״חקהל וחזן עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ. וְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת שִׁמְךָ עַל מַקְדִּישֵׁי שְׁמֶךָ:

tei:div.tei:p:
Those who resolutely subdue their desire, they too were found guilty when examined in justice as though no delight had been found in them. The first man formed from the dust of the earth, who was comparable to the heavenly angels, failed to understand and he became like a mere shadow. To till and care for the garden had God set him apart; when he transgressed His commandment, then he drove him away; but this day became his intercessor. When He awoke that radiant one (Abraham) from the dark, the world had been empty and dark, after twenty generations despised and dejected; though he showed the straight and even path to those who had strayed, yet since he himself said ‘how shall I know’, it was decreed against him ‘you shall surely know’ (the sufferings of your descendants). As for those who pass through the valley of tears to be tested, when the Lord judges the case according to their deeds, who will then be justified before the Judge? The pure one who offered his life as a sacrifice (Isaac), did not find comfort in his old age, for his eyes became dim through the idolatrous smoke of the fool (Esau). He who trained his children in the tents of the Torah (Jacob), since he said ‘My way is hidden’, his offspring (Joseph) was long concealed from him. The wicked man who plots in secret, drives away justice and rejects it, can he hide himself on the day of wrath? When the Lord tested the twelve brothers, He did not pronounce them just, for they had sold the righteous one for silver. The sons of the nameless (Chaldeans), who sold Israel for lechery, wine and violent plunder, how heavy will be their burden when brought to Justice. When the Lord arises to strive, when He
stands upright for justice, for this He will condemn them, that they may know judgment in justice. Yered (Moses), who brought the words of God from Sinai, who led the firstborn (Israel) out from among the Egyptians, he too was punished when he said: ‘Listen, you rebels’. For Israel’s trial of the Lord ten times he shared the penalty, his death was announced to him ten times; and when he reached the border of the Holy Land he was restrained. Judges, when they judge through bribery, how can they expect to be judged with charity? As they have judged others, so shall it be done to them. The youths (Nadab and AbibuAbihu) who offered up strange fire, suffered the decree of wrath as a warning to evil doers among the dispersed people (Israel). The fool desired what was banned, he too was caught within the ban with all that was his, the heaps of corn, the standing corn and vineyard. What avail his deeds to the faithless and the robber, substance avails not on the day of wrath, only entreaty before Him whose teaching avails. He (Usha) stretched out his hand to grasp the Holy Ark, and judgment and wrath overtook him; what shall they do who pass before Him like lambs? When the skilled player on the harp (David) said, ‘Test me’, he was tested; but then he said, ‘Since I am without merit, be lenient with me, do not come in judgment to judge me’. They who call out aloud and blow the Shofar, when their misdeeds are counted in judgment, as an undeserved gift let them be atoned this day. The prince (Uzziah), when he dared to bring incense to the Lord, was marked on the forehead with distinct leprosy and so was he judged for unwitting transgression. When there falters the foot of the proud, who arrogantly entered the Sanctuary, they too will come to be judged by Him who humbles the proud. When those who act falsely come to be tested, with angry argument and question to be judged, then the mouth of those who speak falsehood, will be silenced. The upright (Hezekiah) walked before Him in truth, yet after his good deeds and his truth, the God of truth condemned one of his deeds. The favourite (Josiah) whom none among the chosen of the Lord resembled before or after, was yet severely judged by the Lord. So let all creatures on earth understand, since such was the fate of pillars of the earth, what are the sinners on earth to do. Let them look at
the dense forests; when the fire reaches the fresh trunks, then let the dry and severed ones tremble. Behold there is no man to entreat on behalf of the children of man, but Thou art God and not a man. Let me repeat what is inscribed in the script of truth, the work of all the days of the year, in order to appease Thee with the Shofar sound the memory of the Shofar on this day of the New Year.

tei:div.tei:p: Supreme King. God dwells on high, He is mighty on high, the might of His hand is high, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Strong to fulfil, decreeing and fulfilling, revealing the deep, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Speaking in righteousness, clothed in righteousness, listening to complaints, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Remembering the rocks (forefathers) to justify their descendants, angry with their enemies, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Benevolent, everlasting, His kindness is everlasting, He spreads out the heavens everlasting, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Draped in light as in a gown, He gives light otof all lights, mighty and luminous, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. King of eternity, revealing secrets, making the dumb speak, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Enduring all, ancient and outliving all, investigating all, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. His splendour is strength, the work of His right hand is strong, He delivers and is a refuge, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. His saints are a flame, He summons the ocean’s waters, He is near those who call Him in love, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. There is no sleep before Him, yet His treasures enjoy calm, there is high praise in His treasuries, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. His might is eternal, His glory is eternal, His fame endures forever, He will reign forever.

tei:div.tei:p:
Let us tell of the might of this day’s holiness since it is full of dread and awe. On it Thy Kingdom is exalted and Thy throne made firm with grace and in truth dost Thou sit upon it. It is true that Thou art He who judges and reproves and knows and witnesses and writes and seals and counts and reckons. Thou dost remember all things that are forgotten and Thou dost open the book of memories and it is read out of its own accord and the seal of every man’s hand is on it. Then there is a blast on the great Shofar and a soft and slender sound is heard. The angels hasten to and fro and are seized with trembling and dread so that they say: ‘Behold it is the day of judgment and the host on high
is to be considered in judgment’ for they have no merit in Thine eyes in judgment. Then Thou dost cause all who come into the world to pass before Thee like lambs. Just as a shepherd controlling his herd makes his flock pass beneath his staff, so dost Thou cause to pass, count, reckon and consider every living soul and Thou dost appoint a limit for every creature and inscribe their verdict.

On the New Year they are inscribed and on the Day of Atonement they are sealed, how many shall pass away and how many shall be born, who shall live and who shall die, who at his proper time and who before his time, who by fire and who by water, who by the sword and who by hunger, who by the storm and who by the plague, who shall have rest and who unrest, who shall find repose and who shall be harassed, who shall be calm and who chastised, who raised high and who laid low, who enriched and who impoverished.
Yet Penitence, Prayer and Charity avert the disaster of the decree.

For as Thy Name so is Thy fame. Hard to anger and light to appease, Thou dost not desire the death of the man condemned to death, but that he should turn back from his way and live; until the day of his death dost Thou wait for him, should he repent, Thou wilt at once receive him. In truth Thou art their Creator and Thou knowest their impulse for they are flesh and blood. Man is formed from dust and
his end is dust, at the risk of his life he earns his bread, he is to be compared to a broken potsherd, to dry grass, to a withering flower, to a passing shadow, to a drifting cloud, to a gust of wind, to blown dust and to a fleeting dream.
But Thou art King, O God, living and enduring

There is no limit to Thy years and no end to the length of Thy days, one cannot measure the chariots of Thy glory nor fathom the mystery of Thy Name; Thy Name is fitting for Thee and Thou art fitting for Thy Name and our name hast Thou called by Thy Name. Act for Thy Name’s sake and sanctify Thy Name upon those who sanctify Thy Name.
